participant_1.name: Alex Johnson
participant_1.personality: Energetic and passionate about fitness. Loves to share experiences and connect with others through interests.
participant_1.background: I love Italian food and garlic bread. My favorite color is yellow. I'm a gold medalist Olympian. I workout four hours a day. Gymnastics is my favorite sport.

participant_2.name: Michael Smith
participant_2.personality: Compassionate and reflective, finds joy in serving others and sharing stories from his past.
participant_2.background: I volunteer at a soup kitchen. I like watching war documentaries. I was poor growing up. I'm a retired gym teacher. Cheeseburgers are my favorite food.
